# html2canvas

`html2canvas-1.4.1.min.js` is the unmodified `dist/html2canvas.min.js` from the
`html2canvas@1.4.1` npm package (https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas), licensed
under MIT; see `html2canvas-LICENSE`. It is served locally for editor screenshots
so enabling visual mode does not require a third-party script request.
